case.question: Iran full airspace closure by October 31, 2026?
case.rule_scope: YES criteria: Iran-initiated, non-weather general closure applying to all commercial flights transiting all Iran/Tehran FIR; limited Iran-approved exceptions may qualify. Foreign restrictions, partial/local closures, weather/quakes/volcanoes do not. Window: 2026-09-16T17:53:25.865929Z to 2026-11-01T03:59:00Z.
